page_title: LAZ 1-0 VER | Lazio v Verona 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+2' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' The free kick from close range, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Fabien Centonze (Verona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Lazio will take a free kick.
87' Here's the change. Felipe Anderson leaves the pitch and Matias Vecino (Lazio) comes on as a substitute.
87' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Ciro Immobile (Lazio) replaces Taty Castellanos.
87' Here comes a substitution. Thomas Henry (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Michael Folorunsho.
86' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Diego Coppola (Verona) gets booked.
84' Juan Cabal (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Davide Massa signals.
82' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Lazio is cautioned for aggressive play.
78' The game has come to an end for Jackson Tchatchoua. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Fabien Centonze (Verona).
78' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Darko Lazovic is replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Verona).
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Luis Alberto will be replaced by Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
75' Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
74' Juan Cabal (Verona) will miss the next game.
74' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Juan Cabal (Verona) for his blatant foul.
72' 1 - 0 Goal! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes a short pass from Luis Alberto in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the left post. 1:0.
71' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
71' Luis Alberto (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

69' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is first to the rebound and sends it wide of the target. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
68' Tomas Suslov (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.

66' Pedro (Lazio) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Daichi Kamada. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
63' The cross fools the defence and leaves Luis Alberto (Lazio) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.
62' The free kick from long range, taken by Verona, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
61' Davide Massa interrupts the game. One of the players from Lazio won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Verona win a free kick.
60' Today's match ends for Stefan Mitrovic who will be replaced by Ondrej Duda (Verona).
60' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Karol Swiderski will be replaced by Tomas Suslov (Verona).
60' Igor Tudor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) replacing Gustav Isaksen.
60' Substitution. Pedro (Lazio) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolo Casale walks off.
58' The ball is cleared after Daichi Kamada (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lazio was in an offside position.
56' Davide Massa has a clear sight and sees a foul from Taty Castellanos (Lazio).

54' What a chance that is! Luis Alberto (Lazio) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
52' One of the Verona players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Casale (Lazio) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' OFF THE BAR! Luis Alberto (Lazio) found himself some space to take a shot from just outside the box, but Lorenzo Montipo came up with a save and tipped the ball onto the bar.
48' Lazio work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
46' Dangerous play by Diego Coppola (Verona). Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45' Verona concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
44' 8:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 2:0.
41' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
37' It looks like Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) saw red with that tackle. Davide Massa won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
36' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
34' Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Luis Alberto (Lazio) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
28' Suat Serdar (Verona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
26' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call.
25' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
21' A player from Lazio commits a rough challenge. Davide Massa blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

19' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) inside the box and he manages to steer it low to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
19' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lazio.
18' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Lazio manage to earn a corner.

16' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is behind the touchline and Lazio will take a throw-in.
13' Luis Alberto (Lazio) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
12' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Lazio will take a corner kick.
11' Lazio control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes. 84:16 – the ratio of ball possession.
7' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find Luis Alberto, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
4' A snap shot by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) from distance flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.

3' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Davide Massa with no other option than to blow for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Davide Massa will referee today's match.
